title: Death rate due to road traffic injuries
graph_title: Death rate due to road traffic injuries
national_indicator_available: Death rate due to road traffic injuries
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the number of deaths due to road traffic injuries per 100,000 population.
computation_definitions: The number of road traffic deaths per 100,000 population; the total number of road traffic deaths.
computation_calculations: (Total number of road traffic deaths / Total population) * 100,000
other_info: Data on road traffic injuries are sourced from Rwanda National Police (RNP) records. Additional data on road traffic mortality can be found on the [WHO Data Portal](https://data.who.int/indicators/i/B9D9E6A/D6176E2?m49=646).
comments_limitations: For more details on methodology, see the linked data source.
